summary: mask_secrets returns a string with every previously registered secret (for example via register_secret) replaced by a placeholder, leaving other text unchanged.
questions: How do I redact secrets from a string before logging it?
Does mask_secrets redact any password-looking text?
How do I hide a token in a debug message?

answer_card.title: mask_secrets filter
answer_card.answer_md: `{{ text | mask_secrets }}` replaces each **registered** secret in the string with a placeholder. Only values already registered with the secret masker (e.g. via the `register_secret` filter) are redacted; everything else is unchanged.
